subject: RE: the field
answer: the Fallow Field is let to the society for 21 years at GBP 175 a year, no vehicles when it marks, gateway made good, far hedge untouched
note: the landowner's written permission for the showground and its conditions -- the society has no lease and no premises

subject: water
answer: standpipe supply number 417589, billed to the society, building supply not drinking -- notice required if offered to the public
note: which supply the standpipe is on, who is billed for it and what it may lawfully be used for

subject: trophies
answer: the KKBHX Challenge Cup, for the best animal bred by the exhibitor, stays in the county, returned each July, never to be sold
note: the terms the trophy was left to the society under; the executor is dead and there is no deed

subject: programme
answer: licence WD/196553, capacity 4000, ring roped and stewarded on four sides, entrance kept clear
note: the public entertainment licence and the conditions the show runs under, which renew silently and are stated nowhere else

subject: car park
answer: 6.1 acres of stubble for parking, only if cut and carted, society reinstates the gateway and pays for drain damage, does not run with the farm
note: the parking agreement with the neighbouring farm, personal to the owner and unrecorded elsewhere

subject: accounts
answer: policy CI/2108725, written on the basis of no owned ground and no employees, excess GBP 1200
note: the basis the society's insurance is written on -- the thing that voids it is what is recorded here

subject: RE: the field
answer: ROW/35093, the footpath runs on the diagonal per the definitive map, may be fenced but not obstructed
note: where the right of way actually runs, which is not where it is walked, and what the show may do about it

subject: RE: Saturday
answer: the WI paid GBP 1250 for the entrance gates from centenary money, on condition the plaque stays and the gates are not moved
note: the only record of who paid for the gates and on what terms

subject: RE: Sunday
answer: incident 273308, pony loose from the collecting ring at about 3.10, woman knocked down, seen by St John, declined an ambulance, two steward witnesses
note: the contemporaneous account of the only injury the show has had, with the witnesses and the cause

subject: RE: judging
answer: ruling SQV8 -- a ewe shown with a lamb not her own is out of class 11, judge's decision stood
note: the standing ruling on a class, made once and never written into the schedule

subject: RE: the sheep
answer: tag 58490 turned away by the vet on the day, not notifiable, but on record as turned away once
note: the vet's reason for turning an animal away, which exists nowhere but here

subject: the ring
answer: the ring is underwritten at 75 by 60 metres with ropes four metres off the crowd line on the tannoy side
note: the ring geometry the insurance is written against; set it out smaller and the ridden classes are uncovered

subject: gates
answer: complaint 140976 -- trailer refused at the gate on wet ground, unloaded on the road, a bird lost; no claim made
note: an exhibitor's written complaint and the reference it was given -- the society keeps no complaints book

subject: RE: the young handlers
answer: cover 35223 -- two first aiders and one vehicle at the ring end, conditional on the numbers given
note: the first aid cover the licence depends on and the condition attached to it

subject: tannoy
answer: the show's reserved radio frequency is UTC7, registered to the contractor not the society
note: the frequency the ring party works on, held by a contractor and recorded nowhere the society controls
